description: TradingView MCP tool answers served by tests/fakes/tradingview.py (ticket 31): get_documents, get_document_view and get_news (and, tickets 16b and 16c, the earnings-calendar and get_ohlcv answers: TradingView documents those tools' arguments and the bars' keys, not the calendar's fields, which are Atlas's guess), each file being one tool's JSON answer (the text the fake puts in the tools/call result's text content).
provenance: SYNTHETIC, hand-written for Atlas tests. No TradingView, Quartr or news content: every title, transcript line and headline is made up, the IDs are invented, and the links point at .test hosts. The shapes follow the tool answers described in docs/decisions.md (TradingView MCP findings, ticket 31) and backend/atlas/tradingview/client.py. No TradingView request was made from tests or while writing them.

files.documents-lumentum.json: get_documents for NASDAQ:LITE: a synthetic earnings call (transcript and summary views), a synthetic annual report (summary and pdf views, form 10-K) and a synthetic 2019 call outside the lookback
files.documents-innolight.json: get_documents for HKEX:3308: one synthetic call whose transcript view the fake answers with a tool error (not retrievable)
files.view-syn-view-1001-t.json: get_document_view of the synthetic call's transcript view: an astDescription tree of paragraphs with bold speaker labels and one br; the labels have the shapes production transcripts carry ("Name (Title, Firm)" for the company's officers and an analyst, "Operator" alone), and the analyst repeats the CEO's sentence (pilot-fixes ticket 22: an analyst's words are not the company's)
files.news-lumentum.json: get_news for NASDAQ:LITE: two synthetic headlines (one with a TradingView storyPath, one with a link only)
files.calendar-lumentum.json: (ticket 16b; field names are Atlas's guess) the earnings calendar for NASDAQ:LITE: a reported Q4 FY2026 date (11 Aug 2026), a scheduled Q1 FY2027 date (5 Nov 2026) and a scheduled Q2 FY2027 date (4 Feb 2027); the two scheduled ones carry made-up consensus fields (`eps_estimate`, `revenue_estimate`, `consensus`) that Atlas must drop (ticket 16c)
files.calendar-lumentum-moved.json: the same calendar later: Q1 FY2027 moved to 12 Nov 2026 and confirmed (the fake answers it when `calendar` is set to '-moved')
files.calendar-lumentum-noid.json: (ticket 16b) one Q1 FY2027 date for NASDAQ:LITE with no event ID (the fake answers it when `calendar` is set to '-noid')
files.calendar-innolight-noid.json: (ticket 16b) one Q1 FY2027 date for HKEX:3308 with no event ID: the same fiscal period as Lumentum's, so the two share the fallback key `fy2027-Q1`
files.ohlcv-lumentum-adjusted.json: (ticket 16b/16c) the same bars later, the 1 July close restated (the fake answers it when `prices` is set to '-adjusted')
files.calendar-innolight.json: the earnings calendar for HKEX:3308: no dates
files.ohlcv-lumentum.json: (ticket 16c) get_ohlcv for NASDAQ:LITE in the documented bar shape `{t, o, h, l, c, v}`: five made-up daily bars, 30 June, 1, 2 and 6 July and 3 August 2026 (the tests' July window excludes the first and last)
